nodeOrderNote: A PageSpec must reproduce its template's node list in order, keyed on (section, variant). Nodes are required and non-repeatable unless marked: article-chapter and text-page-chapter repeat (one per real heading-bounded chapter); blog-featured-banner and blog-post-grid are optional on blog-category (empty categories).

home.purpose: Homepage: full product story from promise to proof to conversion.

pricing.purpose: Pricing: plan comparison first, then proof, comparison table, FAQ and closing CTA.

not-found.purpose: Shared 404 ('peekaboo') for unknown paths, the 8 dead sitemap slugs, and linked-but-unbuilt paths (author/reviewer pages, /support).

blog-index.purpose: Blog listing: opener, search, category tabs, featured banner, paginated post grid, closing CTA.

blog-category.purpose: Category listing (same family as blog-index): no announcement bar, category featured set only, always 'Page 1 of 1'.
blog-category.optionalNodeEvidence: health and pregnancy have FEATURED = null: no banner, no cards (measured /blog/health at 1440: tabs -> pagination).

blog-article.purpose: Single article: top bar, header, TOC, intro + H2 chapters, sources, share row, related, closing CTA.

text-page.purpose: Editorial/text page: title + intro, H3-bounded chapters, closing paragraph; no closing CTA.

legal.purpose: Legal policy page (/tos, /privacy, /cookies): chrome around an empty policy-embed slot, as rendered on the original.

deadSlugPolicy.statement: Dead sitemap slugs and linked-but-unbuilt paths map to 'not-found' and may never be bound to any other template (enforced: graph rule ROUTE_TEMPLATE_BINDING).

evidence.anchor: do not create 8 separate landing pages
No shared "landing hero template" is needed

excludedRoutes.statement: Nothing is excluded: every route the clone serves (src/pages/routes.jsx exact + pattern routes expanded over src/data/blogPosts.json) and every linked same-site path is mapped exactly once above.

contentPolicy.longFormText: Blog article bodies and legal/text-page copy are intentionally PLACEHOLDER in the clone (long-form text is not copied). Never treat any long-form body as real Riley copy.
contentPolicy.realStatements: Testimonial quotes/attributions, clinician/author/reviewer names and photos, plan prices/features, promo codes, press logos, competitor names and health/development claims are real-world claims: reuse verbatim only in mode 'clone'; never fabricate or reuse them in mode 'generation'.
contentPolicy.shortUiCopy: Short UI copy in schema/examples/*.clone.pagespec.json is taken verbatim from the built components; *.generated.pagespec.json use original copy for the fictional Brightburrow brand.

globalOverlays.note: Mounted once in App for every route; out of flow (position fixed). Carried in PageSpec.overlays, never in nodes[].
